title: introduce adaptive query tenacity CI gate and seed-variance attenuator
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation:
Recent smoke runs flagged a pattern where a handful of prompt-sets show volatile pass/fail behavior across random seeds and small sampling differences. Those transient failures cause noisy CI noise, frequent rollbacks, and manual triage even when the underlying model quality is stable. This PR introduces an "Adaptive Query Tenacity" CI gate: a soft-gating layer that detects high cross-seed variance at the prompt-set level, automatically escalates targeted re-sampling, and applies a conservative attenuation to SLO enforcement while triage is in progress.

Summary of changes:
- New gate implementation (ci/gates/adaptive_query_tenacity.py) that computes per-prompt-set seed variance, a tenacity score, and a recommended remediation action (replay, quarantine, or weighted-soft-fail).
- Integrations in the eval orchestration path to trigger targeted replays with stratified seed sets instead of full re-evals.
- Small local simulator that models the attenuator behavior to estimate false-positive/false-negative tradeoffs.
- Tests for determinism and end-to-end smoke behavior.
- Documentation and rollout knobs (gates.yaml + docs/ci-gates.md) with guidance for SRE and evaluation owners.

Design notes and heuristics:
- Tenacity score = weighted combination of inter-seed variance, temporal instability (recent windows), and semantic fragility (embedding-distance-based clustering).
- Gate behaves in three modes: observe -> attenuate -> quarantine. Observe collects extra seed samples; attenuate applies a temporary soft-fail (doesn't block merges but flags the SLO); quarantine blocks and opens a ticket if instability persists across windows.
- Default thresholds are conservative to avoid masking real regressions; early rollout is observe-only for two weeks.

Checklist:
- [x] Unit tests for variance estimator and tenacity calculation
- [x] Integration test for targeted replay path
- [x] Documentation for gate config and rollout plan
- [x] Feature flag controlled (gates.yaml) with observe/attenuate/quarantine toggles
- [x] Smoke-runed against nightly canary and validated false-positive rate < 2% in simulation

Commits (summary):
- 9d3f3c1: add adaptive query tenacity gate and core algorithms
- 4b2a0e7: wire gate into eval orchestrator and targeted replay API
- ae7c2d4: add unit + integration tests and synthetic simulator
- b3f9a88: add gate config and docs + rollout guide

Files changed (high-level):
- eval-harness/ci/gates/adaptive_query_tenacity.py  (new) - core gate logic, tenacity scorer, remediation planner
- eval-harness/ci/tests/test_adaptive_tenacity.py  (new) - unit tests and parametric fuzz cases
- eval-harness/eval/orchestrator.py  (mod) - hook to call gate and start targeted replays
- eval-harness/eval/targeted_replay.py  (new) - helper to run stratified seed replays with jittered RNGs
- eval-harness/config/gates.yaml  (mod) - feature flag and threshold values
- eval-harness/docs/ci-gates.md  (mod) - operational guide and rollout steps
- eval-harness/ci/simulator/tenacity_simulator.py  (new) - offline estimator for false-positive testing
- eval-harness/ci/fixtures/seed_samples.json  (new) - synthetic samples for tests
- eval-harness/ci/tests/e2e_smoke_tenacity.sh  (new) - lightweight smoke script used by CI

CI and test behavior:
- Initial CI run showed one flaky integration (timing-dependent test). I added retry/backoff to the e2e smoke script and tightened the RNG seeding in tests.
- Final CI status: all checks passed on the squash commit.
- Performance impact: small CPU overhead for gating calculation (~12ms per prompt-set aggregated) and a minor increase in CI wall-time when observe->replay is triggered; gate is designed to run off the critical path for PR latency by default.

Review notes and rationale for reviewers:
- Arjun: please sanity-check the tenacity scoring math and thresholds, especially the weighting between variance and semantic fragility.
- Sofia: please review the targeted replay API contract and test coverage for end-to-end determinism.
- Liam: please validate ops docs and the rollback/escalation workflow; want to ensure SRE playbooks align with gate outcomes.

Rollout plan:
- Stage 1 (observe-only): enable gate in observe mode for default teams for two weeks; collect telemetry and false-positive rates.
- Stage 2 (attenuate): enable soft-fail for low-tenacity buckets where simulation shows safe attenuation.
- Stage 3 (quarantine): enable blocking only for persistent high-tenacity failures after manual triage.

Potential follow-ups (tracked in ENG-5312):
- Auto-annotator that attaches a replay artifact and suggested corrective prompt edits to the Linear ticket.
- Dashboard widgets in Redwood Console to visualize tenacity trends by prompt-set and model version.

Merge outcome:
- Approved by all reviewers on 2025-03-01.
- Merged via squash on 2025-03-02 after CI green.

Notes on uniqueness: this gate focuses on "tenacity" (cross-seed persistence) rather than absolute SLO deltas or historical baselines and couples automated replay with conservative attenuation. It aims to reduce noisy CI churn while preserving the ability to catch real regressions.

release_notes:
- Add 'Adaptive Query Tenacity' CI gate to detect cross-seed instability and reduce noisy CI failures.
- Targeted replay support for stratified seed re-evals.
- Feature-flagged rollout with observe/attenuate/quarantine modes.
- Operational docs and simulator for false-positive estimation.
